<div class="card-body">
'''Tatooine Utility Belt''' is a [[Light]] [[Device]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">タトゥイーン・ユーティリティ・ベルト</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">１フォース使用し、任意の反乱軍かエイリアンに配備する。タトゥイーンにいる間、そのキャラクターの戦闘力と没収値に＋２。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-40o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">サバイバル用の装備、食料、道具が細かく区分けされ収まっている。バンサの革製で、ルークや他のタトゥイーンの住人たちが使っている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Tatooine Utility Belt.

'''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy on any Rebel or alien. While on Tatooine, that character is power and forfeit +2.

'''Lore:''' Separate compartments hold survival equipment, food, and tools. Made of bantha leather, it is used by Luke and other residents of Tatooine.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Tatooine Utility Belt]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
